risk_if_not_implemented: Without Periodic Scans for Sensitive / Regulated Data, sensitive and/or regulated data may be disclosed, altered or lost through inadequate classification, handling or protection. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Unauthorized Retention / Inability to Dispose of Data (R-AM-3), Unaddressed Security / Compliance Exposure (R-GV-2), and most likely increases susceptibility to Human Error (MT-9), Technical / Mechanical Failure (MT-10).

compensating_control_1.name: Encrypting Data At Rest
compensating_control_1.description: Cryptographic mechanisms exist to prevent the unauthorized disclosure of data at rest.
compensating_control_1.justification: Encrypting Data At Rest (CRY-07) provides cryptographic protection that compensates for the absence of Periodic Scans for Sensitive / Regulated Data (DCH-05.1) by ensuring data confidentiality and integrity through alternative technical means. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Media Storage
compensating_control_2.description:
Mechanisms exist to: 
(1) Physically control and securely store digital and non-digital media within controlled areas using organization-defined security measures; and
(2) Protect system media until the media are destroyed or sanitized using approved equipment, techniques and procedures.
compensating_control_2.justification: Media Storage (DCH-13) provides overlapping security capability that compensates for the absence of Periodic Scans for Sensitive / Regulated Data (DCH-05.1) by addressing related risk objectives through an alternative control mechanism aligned with Technology applicability. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
